people.bob: Payout receiver chosen by an executor

roles.description: Parks funds and runs the lockbox; holds and reclaims the locked balance. Must be the sole authorized executor (locking requires a single successor).

inputs.name: locker_spender_allocations
inputs.note: Parked spend. Its amount and source are bound by conservation.

inputs.name: previous_execution
inputs.note: Re-derived by peers from the executor's own previous RAVE of this agreement.

inputs.name: unlock
inputs.note: Chosen by whoever executes. Validation checks its shape only.

inputs.name: payout_amount
inputs.note: Chosen by whoever executes. Validation checks its shape only.

inputs.name: payout_receiver
inputs.note: Chosen by whoever executes. Validation checks its shape only.

rule_statements.text: A Locker can also be the executor.
rule_statements.basis: executor_rules = Any includes every role member

rule_statements.text: Previous execution is read from each executor's own chain. With anyone able to execute, each executor sees only their own history, so a carried lock is invisible to other executors.
rule_statements.basis: GetPreviousExecution is derived from the executor's chain; executor_rules = Any

rule_statements.text: unlock is chosen by the executor. Only its shape is checked.
payout_amount is chosen by the executor. Only its shape is checked.
payout_receiver is chosen by the executor. Only its shape is checked.

warnings.text: The code writes a `locked` output, so it may create locked value. Under executor_rules Any, a lock is only visible to the executor who created it.
The Locker role description says it must be the sole authorized executor, but executor_rules is Any.
warnings.basis: agreement description vs executor_rules in agreements/agreement_rules_1.json

conclusions.text: An executor who did not park the value can pay it to themselves (carol did in the explored runs). Changing only who executes changed who was paid.
premises: observed: with all other inputs equal, the receiver changed with the executor
caveats: Engine output only. Whether the DNA lets one agent consume links parked for another executor is not visible from the engine.

conclusions.text: The payer, acting as executor, can change where the value goes (destinations seen: alice, bob).
premises: rule: a role member can also be the executor
observed: changing only executor-provided inputs changed the receiver

conclusions.text: This agreement does create locked value while anyone can execute it. The lock is carried only on the executing agent's own chain.
premises: observed: runs with a non-empty locked output
caveats: The DNA is documented to reject a lock created under executor_rules Any. These are engine outputs; they may never commit as RAVEs.
